title: Extraction (assertion) schema with mandatory source spans + ontology normalization
context: Building on the corpus record schema (schema-002), the project needs an extraction (assertion) schema so every extracted statement is grounded and normalizable. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access (PMC OA Subset) / aggregate / de-identified data only; no identifiable patient data; no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. The schema must make a verbatim source span and aggregate-only marking mandatory and forbid any patient-level content or clinical advice.
objective: Define the extraction (assertion) schema with mandatory verbatim source spans and ontology-normalization fields, as a projection-compatible layer over schema-002.
acceptanceCriteria: Each assertion carries a mandatory verbatim source span (PMCID + section + character offsets + quote) consistent with the schema-002 BioC offset model.
Each assertion carries aggregateOnly:true and ontology-normalization fields (ontologyId, ontologyVersion, normConfidence); unmapped entities are flagged and kept as surface forms.
The schema structurally forbids individual-patient content and clinical advice; only aggregate research statements are representable.
At least one worked example assertion record is included; the schema validates in CI; commit is DCO signed-off.
